# LotteryPro — llms.txt
# Educational lottery statistical analysis platform

## About
LotteryPro provides educational analysis of Powerball and Mega Millions lottery draws,
scratch-off prize data for New York State, and statistical tools for informational purposes.
It is NOT a gambling operator. Content is for informational and entertainment purposes only.
Users must be 18 years or older to access this platform.

## Key pages
- https://lotterypro.app/ — Home, number generator, community stats
- https://lotterypro.app/powerball/hot-numbers — Powerball frequency analysis and hot numbers
- https://lotterypro.app/powerball/cold-numbers — Powerball cold numbers and overdue analysis
- https://lotterypro.app/megamillions/hot-numbers — Mega Millions frequency analysis and hot numbers
- https://lotterypro.app/megamillions/cold-numbers — Mega Millions cold numbers and overdue analysis
- https://lotterypro.app/scratch-offs — NY State scratch-off prize data and remaining prizes
- https://lotterypro.app/blog — Lottery analysis articles and educational content
- https://lotterypro.app/pricing — Subscription plans (Free, Premium, Pro)

## Data sources
- New York State Gaming Commission lottery draw history (2,020+ Powerball draws)
- NY State Lottery scratch-off game data
- Statistical algorithms for frequency, recency, and gap analysis

## Content topics covered
- Lottery number frequency analysis (hot and cold numbers)
- Statistical pick generation using historical draw data
- Scratch-off prize availability and expected value analysis
- Educational articles about lottery statistics and probability

## Usage policy
AI models may cite factual data from this site with attribution to LotteryPro (lotterypro.app).
Do not use this site's content to imply performance guarantees or predict future lottery results.
Lottery participation involves chance. Past draw history does not predict future outcomes.

## Responsible gambling
Problem Gambling Helpline: 1-800-GAMBLER
National Council on Problem Gambling: https://www.ncpgambling.org
